title: Search result
description: One listed capability returned by agent_search: public projection, fit and evidence. Never an endpoint.

name.description: The service's name for people, e.g. Extract invoice; may be empty.

data_policy.description: How the provider handles data, in plain words.

price_per_call.description: Amount as a decimal string, e.g. "0.40". Never a float.

provider_tier.description: Trust tier of the provider's organization.

match_reasons.description: Why it matched. A #tag reason means the service carries a tag the query's #tag names, or one above or below it.

tags.description: The service's canonical tags, its category's first (tags_list).

score.description: Fit score; results are ordered by fit, then review evidence.

evidence.description: Receipt-backed outcome counts, with organization diversity.

has_connections.description: Whether the provider has any active connection.

eligible.description: Whether your publisher's rules allow using it.

excluded_by.description: Rules that exclude it, when not eligible.

billing.description: free (every plan is free) or direct (paid runs are paid to the provider itself, on its own page, once it approves them).

payment.description: How the provider takes payment: its payment page, its note and who approves paid runs.

interests.description: The agent's interests; first contact and discussion connections match on them.
